title_en: Call for Applications: 1st Honesty Scholarship (정직장학금) Recipient Selection, 2027
summary: Current third-year students of the College of Engineering who are expected to enter their fourth year in the 2027 academic year may apply for the 2027 1st Honesty Scholarship. Applicants must submit the required documents by email by Wednesday, 2 December 2026; the email address is given in the original notice (it is not reproduced here). Only one student from the College of Engineering will be selected, and the recipient must attend the scholarship award ceremony planned for late February.
applies_to: Optional (by application): current third-year students of this university's College of Engineering who are expected to advance to the fourth year in the 2027 academic year, who have contributed to building a sound academic community, and who show exemplary leadership at regional and national level through consideration for others and positive influence.

dates.what: Deadline for submitting application documents by email
Award ceremony (attendance is mandatory for the selected recipient)

dates.when: During the recipient's third-year second semester

dates.what: Allocation and payment of the scholarship
dates.when: During the recipient's fourth-year first semester

conditions: Only one student will be selected from the College of Engineering.

Candidates must be recommended by their department (school); the College of Engineering Scholarship Committee reviews them after consulting the selection committee members and makes the final selection.
The scholarship is USD 10,000 per year; the won amount changes each year with the exchange rate applied when the fund is transferred (13,296,090 won per person for 2027).
The scholarship is paid as a Development Foundation designated scholarship (발전재단 특지장학금).
The personal statement must include your values developed over your life so far and your resolution for the future.
The recommendation letter may be from a dean, your academic advisor, or someone who knows you.
Evidence of activities during university (volunteering, student council or other group activities, awards and commendations) is submitted only if you have it.
The selected student must attend the scholarship award ceremony planned for late February each year.

In the first year one student each is selected from the College of Engineering and the College of Social Sciences; from the following year one student is selected in alternate years, alternating in the order College of Engineering then College of Social Sciences.
steps: Download and read the attachments on the notice: the 1st Honesty Scholarship operation plan (제1회 정직장학금 운영(안).docx), the personal statement and recommendation letter form (정직장학 자기소개서 및 추천서.hwpx), and the recommendation list form (2027학년도 정직장학생 추천 양식.xlsx). The contents of these attachments were not read for this translation.
Write your personal statement (자기소개서) on the provided form, including your values developed over your life so far and your resolution for the future.
Obtain a recommendation letter (추천서) on the provided form from a dean, your academic advisor, or someone who knows you.
If you have them, gather documents proving your activities during university (volunteering, student council or other group activities, awards and commendations).
Prepare the Honesty Scholarship recommendation list (정직장학생 추천 명단) in the provided Excel form.
Send all documents by email to the address given in the original notice by Wednesday, 2 December 2026.
translation:
2027 1st Honesty Scholarship: Guide to Recipient Selection

Applications are invited for recipients of the 2027 1st Honesty Scholarship (「정직장학금」) as set out below. Students who wish to apply should submit the relevant documents by email by Wednesday, 2 December 2026 (2026.12.2.(수)). [The email address is given in the original notice and is not reproduced here.]

1. Fund overview
- Donors: donors of the Miju Foundation (미주재단) (donations 2023–2025 and 2025) [individual names omitted]
- Purpose: to discover and support talented students who practise sound leadership based on an honest character and a sense of social responsibility, and who contribute to the academic community through consideration for others and positive influence.

2. Eligibility and selection criteria
- Current third-year students of this university's College of Engineering who are expected to advance to the fourth year in the 2027 academic year
- Students who have contributed to building a sound academic community
- Students whose leadership, through consideration for others and positive influence, is a model at regional and national level

3. Selection plan and scholarship payment
- Number selected: 1 student from the College of Engineering
- Amount: USD 10,000 per person per year
 ※ The 2027 amount is 13,296,090 won per person (the won amount changes every year according to the exchange rate applied when the fund is transferred).
- Selection method: students recommended by their department (school) are reviewed by the College of Engineering Scholarship Committee after advice from the selection committee members, and 1 student is finally selected.
- Payment plan: selected in the second semester of the third year; allocated and paid as a Development Foundation designated scholarship (발전재단 특지장학금) in the first semester of the fourth year.
 ※ In the first year, 1 student each is selected from the College of Engineering and the College of Social Sciences; from the following year, 1 student is selected in alternate years (order: College of Engineering → College of Social Sciences).
 ※ The selected student will be invited to the scholarship award ceremony planned for late February each year, and attendance is mandatory.
- Documents to submit
 · Personal statement (자기소개서) (must include your values developed over your life so far and your resolution for the future)
 · Recommendation letter (추천서) (from a dean, academic advisor, or someone who knows you)
 · Academic transcript (성적증명서)
 · Additional submission: evidence of activities during university, if any (volunteering, student council and other group activities, awards and commendations, etc.)
 · Honesty Scholarship recommendation list (정직장학생 추천 명단) (Excel)

Attachments:
1. 1st Honesty Scholarship operation plan (제1회 정직장학금 운영(안)), 1 copy
2. Personal statement and recommendation letter forms, 1 copy each
3. Recommendation list, 1 copy. End.

Attached files (3):
- 2027학년도 정직장학생 추천 양식.xlsx (12 KB)
- 정직장학 자기소개서 및 추천서.hwpx (27 KB)
- 제1회 정직장학금 운영(안).docx (21 KB)

[The contents of the attached files were not read for this translation.]
